rows.description: Can define a simulation scenario in YAML and run it in a sandboxed environment with zero production side effects
Fault injection works -- can inject Read/Write/Bash failures with configurable probability and observe agent behavior
Mock data generation produces realistic synthetic prompts and tool responses
Behavioral invariants are verified at checkpoints (e.g., no-production-writes, graceful-error-handling)
Workflow replay works -- can load a real transcript, mutate it, replay, and detect behavioral drift
Stress testing identifies degradation thresholds (e.g., "agent behavior degrades at 40% tool failure rate")
Reports are generated in Markdown with actionable findings and clear pass/fail summaries
Simulation results can be exported as Evals tasks and suites, feeding into pass@k metrics
Full simulation suite (20 runs) completes within 15 minutes
Sandbox directories auto-clean after configured TTL
